WITH base_pop AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cd4.client_id AS patient_id
  FROM (
      SELECT client_id
          FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
                         FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
                         FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
             INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp ON a.client_id = mdp.patient_id
             LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM person p WHERE p.dead = 1 AND p.death_date <= :endDate) p
             LEFT JOIN mamba_fact_transfer_in mfti ON a.client_id = mfti.client_id
             INNER JOIN (SELECT client_id
          WHERE baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate AND baseline_regimen_start_date < :endDate) a
                       ON a.client_id = p.person_id
                         WHERE cd4 < 200
                           AND encounter_date >= :startDate AND encounter_date < :endDate
                         UNION
                         SELECT client_id
                         WHERE baseline_cd4 < 200
                           AND encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND encounter_datetime < :endDate
  ) cd4
  ON cd4.client_id = a.client_id
  WHERE p.person_id IS NULL
    AND mfti.client_id IS NULL
),
ag AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    ag.label,
    ag.min_age_days,
    ag.max_age_days,
    ag.sort_order
  FROM report_builder_dim_age_group ag
  JOIN report_builder_dim_age_category ac
    ON ac.age_category_id = ag.age_category_id
  WHERE ac.code = 'MOH_105_OPD_DIAG'
    AND ag.is_active = 1
),
genders AS (
  SELECT 'F' AS gender
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M' AS gender
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id AS age_group_id,
    mdp.gender AS gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base_pop.client_id) AS value
  FROM base_pop
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.client_id = base_pop.client_id
  JOIN ag
    ON TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, :endDate)
       BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
  WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IN ('F','M')
  GROUP BY ag.age_group_id, mdp.gender
)
SELECT
  ag.label AS age_group,
  g.gender AS gender,
  COALESCE(cnt.value, 0) AS value
FROM ag
CROSS JOIN genders g
LEFT JOIN cnt
    ON cnt.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id
   AND cnt.gender = g.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, g.gender;
